Tom set it on his windowsill beside the lamp controls, and for the rest of that winter, whenever the fog rolled in thick and the light swept uselessly over empty water, he thought of the stranger who had hoped, and found that he was less alone.", "w02": "凌晨四点的城市，像是被按下了静音键。路灯还亮着，橘黄色的光洒在空荡荡的马路上，没有行人，只有偶尔驶过的清洁车，发出低沉的轰鸣。便利店的玻璃窗里透出一点冷白的光，店员靠在柜台上打瞌睡。远处高楼的轮廓模糊在薄雾里，像一幅还没画完的画。偶尔有一只野猫从巷子里窜出来，又迅速消失在阴影中。整座城市仿佛在喘息，积蓄着白天的喧嚣再度降临前的最后一点安静。风很轻，带着一点凉意，吹过空无一人的广场，只留下自己的脚步声回响。", "w03": "Recursion is when a function solves a big problem by calling itself to solve a smaller version of the same problem.\nIt needs a 'base case', a point where the problem is so small it can just answer directly without calling itself again.\nLike a set of Russian nesting dolls: you keep opening smaller dolls until you reach the tiniest one that doesn't open anymore."}
